assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone high-resolution 2D fighting-game sprite for an archive of Half-Life cut creatures.
Input image 1 is the original red Diablo/Panther Eye model sheet by Chuck Jones, with several views of the SAME creature. Use it as the sole character-design reference.
Primary request: redraw exactly ONE red Panther Eye, full body, in a grounded neutral ready stance, facing LEFT, almost true lateral view with just enough three-quarter visibility to read the huge front eye. Preserve the source silhouette and all characteristic anatomy. This is the RED Diablo reference, never the blue version.
The source has a muscular quadrupedal red body, dark charcoal segmented plates inset in the sides, a jagged ridged carapace above the shoulders, one enormous glossy red forward eye, a small underslung mouth with sparse pale triangular teeth, four heavy legs with grey armored toes and claws, and a long narrow segmented tapering tail. Keep the reference's red / charcoal / grey palette and its exact panel shapes. No fur, no horns added, no extra eyes, no equipment.
Style/medium: crisp detailed painted raster game sprite, faithful to the old model's anatomy and material placement, modest extra surface detail only, no reinvention.
Composition: one creature only, entire body and full tail visible, readable silhouette, generous transparent margin around all extremities; landscape canvas approximately 2048x1536.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no floor, no backdrop, no shadow plane, no scenery.
Constraints: NOT a sprite sheet, not a turnaround, no duplicate views or extra creatures. No text, watermark, border, frame, logo. Fidelity to the supplied original design takes priority over dramatic styling.

source_references.provenance: Planche du modèle rouge Diablo de Chuck Jones, hébergée par Combine OverWiki; la page de fichier renvoie au portfolio de l’auteur. Le fichier visuel a été téléchargé et inspecté directement; aucune révision exécutable exacte n’en est déduite.

visual_qa.notes: Silhouette, œil rouge lisse, plaques latérales sombres, crêtes, quatre membres et queue reproduits d’après la planche. Détails de surface plus fins que le modèle; géométrie des doigts, dents et plaques à comparer plus précisément. Les faibles traces alpha hors silhouette restent présentes.

assets.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Input image is the existing blue alpha Panther Eye sprite candidate to edit.
Change ONLY the background and alpha mask: remove every white/grey haze, white matte, checkerboard remnant and cast shadow around and between the creature's limbs. The background and empty gaps must be genuinely 100% transparent (alpha 0), with a tight clean natural antialiased contour.
Preserve the entire creature exactly: same silhouette, pose, size, location, all dark navy/black panels, red compound eye, blue limbs, grey triangular claws, materials, color, texture and perspective. No repainting or redesigning any part of the creature. Make the creature opaque apart from the normal thin antialiased edge; do not leave its body translucent.
Keep one complete creature, no cropping, no text, no border, no shadow or glow. Output PNG with real transparency.

source_references.provenance: Rendu du modèle bleu Half-Life Alpha hébergé par Combine OverWiki; image de référence inspectée. Aucun build divulgué n’a été téléchargé ni exécuté.

assets.reference_scope: Correction du fond à partir de la première sortie; référence source originale visuellement inspectée et conservée dans la provenance. La pose reste front-trois-quarts pour éviter d’inventer un profil caché.

visual_qa.notes: Voile visible supprimé; rendu inspecté sur fonds clair et sombre. L’œil composé, palette bleue et pose front-trois-quarts restent cohérents avec l’original. assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single high-resolution raster creature sprite for the Half-Life cut-content archive.
Input image 1 is the ORIGINAL Half-Life Stukabat model render with its original in-game textures; it is the only visual reference. Match that exact revision, not a fan remake or "redux" version.
Primary request: make ONE full-body Stukabat in a readable flying idle pose, facing RIGHT, wings extended just as in the reference. Keep the long narrow forward-projecting head/neck, the visible row of three small red eyes on its side (six eyes total), dark body, pointed hooked jaws at the forward tip, angular extended dark wing supports, broad triangular purple-red membranous wings, short dorsal spines, and the single rear leg visible behind the body. Retain the black, violet and dark scarlet texture placement and unusual anatomy.
The pose is a side-view fighting-game flying enemy with a slight three-quarter angle to make both wings visible, based directly on the supplied original pose. Do not turn it into a real-world bat or dragon: no fur, no extra legs, no cute face, no new horns, no new tail design, no glowing mouth or aura.
Style: crisp detailed raster game art with faithful original angular contour and material placements; improve edge clarity without redesigning the creature.
Composition: exactly one creature, the entire wingspan, snout and rear appendage visible with generous margin, landscape canvas around 2048x1536.
Scene: genuine transparent alpha background; no scenery, floor, dust, motion blur or cast-shadow plane.
No text, border, watermark, sprite sheet, duplicates or separate parts.
